{{Quote|Any idea why they sent you?''"<br />"''The Supreme Chancellor thinks you're wasted out here. Beyond that, I don't know.|Jace Malcom asks the Jedi Knight why he has been recalled aboard the ''Frontier Justice''|<ref name="TLBoCJM" />}}
The '''''Frontier Justice''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Kalandis Seven)|Jedi Knight]] who was personally selected by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was given an order to recall [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]], where the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] was fighting on the [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|front lines]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], and the Knight was assigned the ''Frontier Justice'' as a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to bring Malcom back to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Jedi flew the ''Frontier Justice'' and [[Space warfare/Legends|battled]] through half a dozen [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] to reach the [[Kalandis system/Legends|Kalandis system]].

==Description==
The ''Frontier Justice'' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], a [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], and a spartan barracks that doubled as personal guest quarters with a [[Sleeper (furniture)|cot]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==History==
[[File:JaceMalcom-Hope.png|thumb|right|120px|The ''Frontier Justice''{{'s}} passenger Jace Malcom]]
The ''Frontier Justice'' was given as a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Kalandis Seven)|Jedi Knight]] in [[3640 BBY]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had been ordered by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] to recall [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]], where Malcom was [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|fighting]] in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], and transport him back to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] flew the ''Frontier Justice'' and had to [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] through six [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] to arrive at Kalandis Seven on schedule. After collecting his passenger, the Knight set in their destination and proceeded to repair the ship's damaged [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] console, which had sustained damaged at some point.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Frontier Justice'' was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in author [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', which was released on [[October 2]], [[2012]]. The ship first appeared and was identified as the ''Frontier Justice'' in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story, ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'', which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]] and was released on [[October 23]], 2012.
